body:
DELIVERED + honestly scoped (codex-reviewed). Commits aec2f3f5 + fd9fdef3.
Tests (AC 1-3) all pass independently:
- ac_txn_3_request_id_replay_all_ops_all_cut_points: ok
- ac_txn_3_mid_pipeline_cut_is_request_id_bearing: ok
- cargo test -p pqueue-conformance -p pqueue-engine: 0 failed; cargo test -p pqueue-server: 0 failed.

WHAT WAS CLOSED: commit_transition is the 2nd request_id-bearing op. Its in-memory commit_idempotency
cache was empty on reopen with no log rebuild, so a post-restart retry of an already-committed request_id
was lease-fenced (0-duplicate but not an unknown-outcome cached replay). Added
ComposedBackend::rebuild_commit_idempotency_from_log (folds the durable log, reconstructs each committed
EntryRecovery, stamps request_fingerprint) called beside the push rebuild. commit_transition request_id
replay across restart at AfterAppendBeforeApply + AfterApplyBeforeResponse is now PROVEN for sqlite_log
and postgres (postgres run LIVE against the reachable DB), with a real drop+reopen and 0-duplicate
assertions on projected state (codex confirmed the restart is genuine, not same-instance).

HONEST RESIDUAL (AC #4 not fully met, split out): a VECTORIZED commit that MIXES committed + rejected
entries cannot be faithfully replayed across restart — rejected entries append nothing durable, so
reconstruction is short. Rather than return a misleading short vec, the replay path guards on
recovery.len() == entries.len() (compose.rs:3544): a short reconstructed record falls through to SAFE
0-duplicate re-execution (committed inputs stay finalized exactly once, commit_validate-fenced). A
mixed-commit across-restart test proves 0-duplicate + no false-complete. So sqlite_log/postgres AC-TXN-3
are honestly recorded PARTIAL with a precise GAP (not a faked pass). Faithful mixed replay needs durable
per-entry rejection records (a deferred wire-format change) — tracked in pqueue-db60657d (P2).

Closing this bead for the delivered all-committed across-restart scope; the mixed-commit faithfulness
sub-case discovered during the work is tracked in pqueue-db60657d.
summary: commit_transition across-restart replay proven (all-committed, live pg); mixed-commit residual guarded+split to pqueue-db60657d
